brief:
Israeli authorities have issued demolition notices for buildings in Hebron, sparking fear among Palestinians that the move signals a campaign of forced displacement, Al Jazeera English reported. The notices target structures that Palestinians say are legally licensed, raising concerns about the security of residential properties in the West Bank city.

The development has heightened alarm among residents already facing housing insecurity. Palestinians worry the demolitions represent an escalating effort to remove them from their homes in the disputed territory.
dek: Palestinians fear forced displacement as Israeli authorities target legally licensed homes in West Bank.
title: Israeli authorities issue demolition notices for licensed Palestinian homes in Hebron
